results.name: feed_start_address
results.why: the block is fed from ring position 0, not from its start

results.name: collect_one_more
results.why: a block collects B + 1 samples

results.name: credit_ignored
results.why: a block starts although the output FIFO may lack room for its results

results.name: credit_n_words
results.why: only N words of output room are credited: a block with B above N/2 waits for the previous block's results to drain, so the block period is no longer B + N + 1

results.name: sof_always
results.why: every fed word is a start of frame

results.name: ring_write_swapped
results.why: real and imaginary parts exchanged on the way into the ring

results.name: inverse_is_forward
results.why: the second transform is a forward one

results.name: forward_bit_reversed
results.why: the forward transform emits bit-reversed order but the filter is in natural order

results.name: inverse_unscaled
results.why: the inverse transform is not scaled by 1/N

results.name: product_round_quarter
results.why: the spectral product's rounding constant is a quarter instead of a half

results.name: filter_swapped_m4
results.why: the four-multiplier product has the filter's real and imaginary parts exchanged

results.name: filter_swapped_m3
results.why: the three-multiplier product has the filter's real and imaginary parts exchanged

results.name: filter_halves_read_swapped
results.why: the real part of the filter word is read from the imaginary half

results.name: spectrum_real_swapped
results.why: the spectral product takes the imaginary part as the real one

results.name: drop_count_off
results.why: one valid output too many is dropped

results.name: sat_real_only
results.why: an imaginary part that saturates is not flagged

results.name: clamp_low_to_high
results.why: a part below the range saturates to the positive end

results.name: imag_from_real
results.why: the imaginary output part is the real one

results.name: busy_ignores_blocks
results.why: BUSY is 0 while a block is in flight: coefficient commits are accepted

results.name: busy_ignores_clear
results.why: BUSY is 0 while the memories are cleared

results.name: blocks_counter
results.why: the block counter counts in twos

results.name: fifo_reads_empty
results.why: the FIFO is read although it may be empty

results.name: fifo_no_hold
results.why: the output register is not held while the sink stalls: words are lost

results.name: fifo_data_not_held
results.why: the output data changes while the sink stalls

results.name: out_valid_follows_ready
results.why: tvalid depends on tready (an AXI4-Stream rule violation)

results.name: axil_partial_strobes
results.why: writes with partial strobes are accepted

results.name: axil_status_bit
results.why: DROPPED is cleared by bit 0

results.name: axil_caddr_plus_one
results.why: COEF_ADDR is written with the value plus one

results.name: axil_no_autoincrement
results.why: COEF_ADDR does not advance after a commit

results.name: axil_refusal_ok
results.why: a refused commit answers OKAY

results.name: axil_commit_register
results.why: the commit fires on the COEF_RE write instead of the COEF_IM write

results.name: axil_stage_register
results.why: COEF_RE is staged by a write to COEF_ADDR

results.name: axil_unmapped_read_ok
results.why: an unmapped read answers OKAY

results.name: axil_readback_register
results.why: COEF_ADDR reads back the staged real part

results.name: axil_cfg_swapped
results.why: CFG0 has W and LOGN exchanged

results.name: axil_ro_write_ok
results.why: a write to a read-only or unmapped register answers OKAY

results.name: axil_address_bits
results.why: the write address decode uses the wrong bits
